tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mdor bsdus bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ rdo rje 'chang dbang bdag med bir+wa pa// nag po ḍā ru a wa dhu ti'i zhabs// gha ya dha ra 'brog mi se ston rje// zhang ston sa chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rje btsun sku mched chos rje khu dbon gnyis// zhang dkon brag phug pa dang bsod rgyal rje// dpal tshul bud+dha shrī ngor chen dang*// dkon rgyal bdag chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rdo ring pa dang kun legs tshar pa rje// mkhyen brtse dbang phyug bslab rgyal dbang rab mtshan// bka' 'gyur ba dang khyab bdag zhwa lu ba// mkhyen rab byams pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rmor chen gnas gsar rje dang kun blo'i mtshan// bstan lhun bod 'brug pa dang khri chen rje// phyogs rnam snyan grags mgon dang mkhyen brtse can// kun bstan rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla mar gsol btab cing*// 'khor 'das gnyis med skyabs sems zung ldan gyis// sgrib gnyis chu 'dzin bcom pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi// nyams rtogs rta ljang dbyings su 'char bar shog /

ces lam 'bras bla brgyud mdor bsdus sh+lau ka dbang po'i grangs khongs su 'thus pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes rgyal smad bla ming legs 'byor mchog nas bkas bskul ma stsal ba ltar bco brgyad pa mkhyen brtse'i ming can gyis bris so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
